claims.claim: Insubong (인수봉, also written Insu-bong) is a roped-climbing destination in Seoul’s Bukhansan area. Its appeal is a full mountain day on granite slabs, cracks and multipitch terrain. The [Mountain Project area description](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/106225638/insu-bong-bukhansan) describes traditional climbing and also warns of very widely spaced protection on some sport climbs. A familiar numerical grade should not turn this into the outdoor equivalent of a gym route.
